title: Normalized strict scalar-balancing data
statement: Let A be a commutative ring with adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and let T be a scheme. Use the small pro-etale site of [def-weil-size-convention] and the geometric inverse image of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put R_T equal to the constant ring sheaf and B_T equal to the actual inverse limit of its finite quotient sheaves from [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]; the scalar map is its quotient-cone map. Use scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] and K-flatness [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Record the actual strict derived quotient tower and exact constant-diagram functor. Ordinary module pullback is algebraic inverse image followed by scalar extension along the projection-defined coefficient map, whose geometry is supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image] and [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Towers are derived before evaluation, consistently with [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization]. Define PullModel by exact localization factorizations and their universal left-derived properties. Define the representative-computation and insertion-normalization predicates, PullCompatibility by the ordinary and derived scalar and quotient-reassociation comparisons with their cube equation, and Balancing by scalar balancing, both augmented units, constant-diagram restriction and their augmentation equation, together with PullCompatibility for every scheme morphism. The comparisons have the directions and flat coefficient restriction conventions of [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ringed-diagram-restriction]. All are the existing concrete definitions, unchanged in type and body.
